title: Implement TurnStrategy interface and implementations
description: Create TurnStrategy interface (getNextActor, isPhaseComplete). Implement SequentialTurnStrategy, InitiativeTurnStrategy, and SimultaneousTurnStrategy. Each strategy determines who acts next based on different logic.

title: Implement TargetSelector for action targeting
description: Create TargetSelector that validates and filters valid targets based on TargetType (self, single_ally, single_enemy, all_allies, etc.). Should return list of valid entities given current combat state.

title: Implement EventBus for event-driven architecture
description: Create pub/sub event system with priority-ordered listeners. Support event emission, listener registration with priority, event modification/cancellation by listeners, and immutable event objects.

title: Implement CombatController for combat orchestration
description: Create CombatController that orchestrates combat flow: initialize, turn loop, action execution, event emission, victory checking. Delegates turn ordering to TurnStrategy. Provides main API for running combat simulations.

title: Implement Passive and Equipment classes
description: Create Passive (permanent modifier source) and Equipment (togglable modifier source) classes. Both should integrate with Entity modifier collection and support loading from JSON schemas.

title: Implement Effect system
description: Create Effect base class and concrete effect types (DamageEffect, HealEffect, ApplyStatusEffect, etc.). Each effect should evaluate its formula and apply state changes. Support effect targeting (self, selected, all).

title: Implement Entity class
description: Create Entity class that contains attributes, resources, tags, and modifier sources (passives, equipment, status effects). Support loading from JSON, attribute/resource access, modifier collection, and state serialization.

title: Implement Attribute class with modifier support
description: Create Attribute class that stores base value and uses ModifierStack to compute final value. Support attribute reading, modifier collection from entity sources, and cache invalidation.

title: Write comprehensive tests for all components
description: Create unit tests for each class (modifiers, formulas, entities, actions, combat). Create integration tests for complete combat scenarios. Ensure determinism tests verify same seed = same outcome. Target high code coverage.

title: Add simulation API for AI planning
description: Implement readonly simulation methods that allow previewing action outcomes without mutating state. Support instance.simulate(action, target) that returns StateChange with predicted damage, healing, status effects, etc.

title: Implement StatusEffect with duration and ticking
description: Create StatusEffect class: temporary modifier source with duration tracking, tick behavior, stacking rules (replace/stack/refresh), and on-tick effects. Should integrate with modifier system and emit appropriate events.

title: Implement Resource class (bounded attribute)
description: Create Resource class extending Attribute concept with current/max bounds. Support get/set current, compute max via modifiers, emit events on depletion, and enforce min/max constraints.

title: Implement RandomSource with seeded PRNG
description: Create deterministic random number generator using a seeded PRNG algorithm (e.g., Mulberry32 or similar). Must support: next() for [0,1), nextInt(min, max), choose(array), and serialize/deserialize state.

title: Create JSON schemas and validation
description: Define JSON schemas for all game objects (entity, action, status effect, passive, equipment, instance config) using JSON Schema format. Integrate ajv for strict validation. Validation should occur on data load.

title: Implement Instance (combat state container)
description: Create Instance class that manages combat state: entities, turn order, history, configuration. Support state queries, action execution, victory condition checking, and full serialization/deserialization.

title: Implement Modifier and ModifierStack
description: Create Modifier class and ModifierStack calculation engine. Must handle add/multiply/set/min/max types, conditional modifiers, deterministic sorting (priority→type→source→creation order), and caching with dirty flags. This is the core extension mechanism.

title: Implement Formula evaluator for string expressions
description: Create safe expression evaluator for formulas. Support basic math operators, comparisons, ternary, dot access, and built-in functions (max, min, floor, ceil, abs, clamp). No assignments or loops. Must evaluate with provided context (attacker, target, action, random).

title: Implement Action class
description: Create Action class that defines what entities can do. Support target selection, cost checking, condition evaluation, effect application, and loading from JSON. Should integrate with TargetSelector and Effect system.
